AI Notes.value: Six N. Five is the Barcelona-based CGI and digital art studio of Argentinian founder Ezequiel Pini (b. 1985), co-founded 2014 in Buenos Aires, relocated to Barcelona 2016. Pini studied graphic design at the University of Buenos Aires; he co-founded the studio with Andy Reisinger, who departed around 2017. The studio operates as an independent creative practice (Work Status: Studio) with 2-10 staff (LinkedIn lists ~8 employees including Emile van de Coevering, Marco Segovia, Nico Barsky). Seniority: founder and creative director level, ~12 years running his own studio; one of the most recognized names in 3D digital art globally. Clients include Apple, Burberry, Cartier, IKEA, Meta, Microsoft (Windows 11 Bloom wallpaper), Nike, Rimowa, Samsung, Spotify. Exhibited at Art Basel, Moco Museum, Frieze NY, Fotografiska Stockholm, Sotheby's Hong Kong (2023). Also produces physical collectibles (chairs, sculptures). Autonomy: 5 (fully independent studio, sets its own creative vision, founder-led). Email info@sixnfive.com confirmed on site.
